justification: The package is a large, centralized hub: there are 18 production classes in gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind totaling 4,538 LOC, and they cover many distinct responsibilities (basic adapters in TypeAdapters.java, reflection-based binding in ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.java, tree I/O in JsonTreeReader/JsonTreeWriter, and collection/map/array/enum/date/time adapters). Gson.java:322-399 shows the core Gson constructor wiring this package into the main serialization pipeline by registering many factories and adapters from it, so responsibility is concentrated rather than narrowly focused.
